title: chrysanthemum coronopifolium subsp. ceratophylloides
intro: Chrysanthemum coronopifolium subsp. ceratophylloides, commonly known as a type of flowering plant, is a subspecies of the Chrysanthemum coronopifolium species. It is valued for its medicinal properties and has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Chrysanthemum coronopifolium subsp. ceratophylloides include reducing fever, alleviating headache, and soothing respiratory issues, attributed to its bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and triterpenoids. These bioactive constituents contribute to the plant's potential health benefits, including reducing inflammation, improving cardiovascular health, and exhibiting antimicrobial and antiviral activities.
